title: Generalize AGENTS.md into the shared agents.md entry and register OpenCode across routing docs
body:
## Background

Part of the OpenCode support roadmap (#1413). OpenCode resolves project rules by loading the first matching filename among `AGENTS.md` → `CLAUDE.md` → `CONTEXT.md` walking up from the cwd; a dedicated `OPENCODE.md` would never auto-load (https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/). This repository's `AGENTS.md` is currently branded as the Codex CLI entry ("This file contains tool-specific guidance for Codex", `AGENTS.md:11-14`), so OpenCode sessions in this repository already read guidance addressed to a different tool.

Verified against current `main`:

- `tests/agent-entry-mirror-sync.test.mts` hardcodes `FILES = ['CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'GEMINI.md']` and `TOOL_NAMES = { 'AGENTS.md': 'Codex', ... }` (lines 9-16). The canonical-reference test (lines 136-158) requires each entry file's canonical-reference paragraph to name its own tool and not the other files' tools; naming "OpenCode" in `AGENTS.md` would pass today but is not asserted.
- The issue-authoring-section test (lines 84-134) requires `AGENTS.md` and `GEMINI.md` to carry byte-identical sections without the strings `.claude/skills/` or `Claude`, so OpenCode's skill auto-discovery (it reads `.claude/skills/` bundles natively; https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) cannot be noted inside `AGENTS.md` without a test redesign — document it in `docs/idd-workflow.md` instead, and leave the `AGENTS.md` issue-authoring section untouched.
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md:17-20` enumerates the compatibility entry points as "`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `GEMINI.md` … for Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI respectively".
- `docs/idd-workflow.md` "Entry points and auto-load expectations" table (lines 27-32) has one row per agent and no OpenCode row; the critique-pass table (lines 492-497) likewise. Both this file and `idd-template/docs/idd-workflow.md` are hand-maintained copies kept aligned by a `structure`-mode audit — table rows must be edited in both copies in the same change.
- `README.md:243-246` ("Agent choice — The core loop works across GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI") and the entry-file mentions at `README.md:52` and `README.md:262-265` do not mention OpenCode; `README.ja.md` mirrors these. The audit's `readmePairs` check enforces only heading-level parity — the sentence-level paired edit in the same commit is the repo convention stated in the entry files and `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

## Proposed change

Rebrand `AGENTS.md` as the shared entry for agents.md-standard runtimes and register OpenCode in the routing docs:

- Rewrite the `AGENTS.md` canonical-reference paragraph to address agents that read the agents.md standard — currently Codex CLI and OpenCode — keeping the "apply the intent in your own interaction model" framing tool-neutral. Do not touch the shared sections (the mirror test keeps them byte-identical across the three entry files).
- Extend `tests/agent-entry-mirror-sync.test.mts` so the `AGENTS.md` canonical-reference assertion requires both "Codex" and "OpenCode", and `CLAUDE.md`/`GEMINI.md` must not name "OpenCode".
- Update `.github/copilot-instructions.md:17-20` so the enumeration states `AGENTS.md` serves Codex CLI and OpenCode.
- Add an OpenCode row to both tables in `docs/idd-workflow.md` and `idd-template/docs/idd-workflow.md`: entry-points row — read first `AGENTS.md` (OpenCode's native rules mechanism auto-loads it), nothing automatically available from `.github/instructions/`, manual open of `idd-overview-core.instructions.md` plus the routed phase file; critique-pass row — launch a subagent via OpenCode's Task tool (e.g. the built-in `general` subagent or a `subtask: true` command), which counts as an independent mechanism. Also add OpenCode to the intro agent list (lines 4-5) and a short note near the entry-points table that OpenCode discovers the `issue-authoring` skill bundle through its `.claude/skills/` compatibility. In the `idd-template/docs/idd-workflow.md` copy, word that note conditionally ("when the issue-authoring companion bundle is installed under `.claude/skills/`…"): the bundle is an optional companion for downstream adopters (see `README.md:267-273`), so an unconditional statement would be wrong in most target repositories.
- Add OpenCode to the README agent-choice sentence and entry-file mentions, applying the equivalent edit to `README.ja.md` in the same commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` addresses Codex CLI and OpenCode in its canonical-reference paragraph; the shared sections are unchanged.
- [ ] `tests/agent-entry-mirror-sync.test.mts` asserts the new naming rules; `pnpm test` is green.
- [ ] `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, both `docs/idd-workflow.md` copies (both tables, intro list, and the skills-discovery note), `README.md`, and `README.ja.md` name OpenCode consistently.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.
